remarks: Welcome to this meticulously maintained two-level townhome style duplex, perfectly situated in a quiet neighborhood just a short stroll to the train, shops, and New Canaan's vibrant town center. Step inside to discover a kitchen that is updated with stainless steel appliances, a fantastic open-concept layout with newer hardwood floors, a spacious dining area, and an oversized living room that's perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. In addition, there is 1.5 updated baths, two generously sized bedrooms with ample closet space, central air, and washer and dryer in-unit. Enjoy outdoor living with a patio and a large backyard perfect for outdoor play and relaxing. This home offers comfort, style, and access to everything New Canaan has to offer-including top-rated schools, restaurants, and more.
